subject: MAP re-anchor request — proposed rebaseline for CloudScale evaluation
messages:
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Lawson <emma@cloudscale.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP re-anchor request — short notice on procurement delay

Hi Emma,

Quick note after this morning's sync — procurement just flagged an internal PO hold that will push their legal review out by roughly two weeks. Given the gating items in our current MAP, I think we should formally "re-anchor" the mutual action plan rather than let the close date float.

I propose we:
- Publish a modest rebaseline with two options (soft two-week buffer or a longer four-week buffer with a staggered rollout)
- Lock in an updated evaluation cutoff and a revised go/no-go decision date
- Add a short risk log entry to capture the PO/contract dependency and an owner for escalations

Can you confirm whether procurement's updated ETA is mid-September? If so I'll circulate a concrete MAP v2 and an escalation path for executive sign-off.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0132

Attachment: none in this message

From: Emma Lawson <emma@cloudscale.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jason Park <jason.park@cloudscale.com>, procurement@cloudscale.com
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 09:52:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP re-anchor request — short notice on procurement delay

Laura,

Thanks for the heads up. Correct — procurement bumped legal review; their internal approval window is now targeting the week of Sep 13. That's the earliest realistic PO date unless we push for an exception.

We're still committed to the eval but cannot signoff before procurement clears. For transparency I've attached our internal TACs and procurement contact list so you can see the gating constraints.

Two quick asks from our side:
1) Can Redwood keep the evaluation environment up for an extra two weeks at the current resource allocation?
2) If we rebaseline, can we get a revised success criteria doc so our PMs know what will be measured at the new cutoff?

Emma Lawson
Director of Product, CloudScale
emma@cloudscale.com

Attachments: CloudScale_TACs.pdf

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Lawson <emma@cloudscale.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP re-anchor request — short notice on procurement delay

Emma — thanks and appreciated.

We can keep the evaluation environment live for two weeks with no changes; for a four-week extension we'll need to apply a temporary credit or reallocate dedicated capacity (I looped Marissa for procurement/finance levers).

I've sketched two rebaseline options below — if you confirm which you prefer I'll issue MAP v2 with updated milestones and owners:

Option A — Two-week soft buffer
- New evaluation cutoff: 2027-09-03
- Go/no-go decision: 2027-09-06
- Redwood: maintain eval infra (no charge) through 2027-09-10
- Risk: procurement slip to Sep 13 -> contingency: staggered rollout for non-P0 features

Option B — Four-week guarded buffer
- New evaluation cutoff: 2027-09-17
- Go/no-go decision: 2027-09-20
- Redwood: maintain dedicated eval capacity (reduced) + 25% credit for extended window
- Risk: internal PO push might still slip; contingency: pre-approved fallback model variant and limited-scale go-live

Action requested: pick A or B and confirm procurement contact to include on the MAP update.

I'll also add a one-line risk entry and owner to the MAP (PO dependency) so we have an explicit escalation path.

Best,
Laura

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: MAP re-anchor — risk log and product gating

Laura / Grace,

Quick internal note:
- Added an entry in our internal risk_log.csv: row -> CS-4129 | PO dependency | Jason Park (CloudScale) | Impact: delay to GA milestone | Mitigation: temporary capacity + credit option (owner: Jonas Weber)
- Product flagged one P1 feature that requires a minor API contract change (ETA 1 week). If procurement is late and we can't ship the P1, we should prepare a fallback plan to ship without it; P1 owner: Priya Natarajan (cc'd on product side in our system).

Recommend we:
1) Offer Option B to buy headroom and include a conditional clause in MAP v2 that allows rollback to Option A if procurement accelerates.
2) Surface this to Customer Success for readiness (Grace to lead).

I'll ping Marissa for the finance approval path if we go with the credit.

-Jonas

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Emma Lawson <emma@cloudscale.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 11:12:00 -0700

Finance is ok to provide a temporary 25% credit for a four-week guarded buffer (Option B) pending a signed PO or a confirmed DocuSign extension by Sep 17. I'll coordinate with procurement to accept a conditional extension signature that ties the credit to PO issuance.

Subject: MAP v2 issued — confirmed re-anchor and escalation guardrails

Emma / Jason —

Thanks for the quick responses. Per consensus from CloudScale + Redwood: we will adopt Option B (four-week guarded buffer) and publish MAP v2 with the following highlights:

- Evaluation cutoff: 2027-09-17
- Decision date: 2027-09-20
- Redwood concession: 25% credit for extended evaluation window contingent on DocuSign extension or PO by 2027-09-17
- Escalation owner: Jonas Weber (redwood) / Jason Park (cloudscale procurement)
- Fallback: staggered feature rollout; remove API-dependent P1 if PO issuance slips beyond Sep 24

I attached the updated MAP spreadsheet and the risk log extract for your records. Please review and reply-all with a signed extension or PO URL — Marissa will process the credit once we have the DocuSign link.
